facts.statement: A hand is the set of cards a player holds.
facts.sourceSentence: Hand: The cards each player holds.

facts.statement: Each player begins the game with 3 cards in hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Hand: The cards each player holds. Each starts with 3 and ends the game with 10.

facts.statement: Each player finishes the game holding 10 cards.
facts.sourceSentence: Hand: The cards each player holds. Each starts with 3 and ends the game with 10.

facts.statement: A set is a group of cards whose numbers all match, requiring a minimum of 2 cards.
Three cards showing 5, 5, 5 is given as an example of a set.
A run is a group of cards in consecutive numeric order, requiring a minimum of 3 cards.
Cards showing 5, 6, 7 is given as an example of a run.
Card numbers span the range 1 through 7.
facts.sourceSentence: There are numbers ranging from 1-7 in 4 colors, with 4 copies of each card.
There are numbers ranging from 1-7 in 4 colors, with 4 copies of each card.

facts.statement: Each distinct card exists in 4 copies.
facts.sourceSentence: There are numbers ranging from 1-7 in 4 colors, with 4 copies of each card.

facts.statement: The game also includes 7 bonus point cards.
facts.sourceSentence: In addition, there are 7 bonus point cards.

facts.statement: The game's designer is JT Smith.
The game credits a list of play testers, beginning with Patrick Galagan and ending with Marylin Vanderhoof.
